faq.q: Do I need to change my accounting software?
faq.a: No. ARQ reads from Tally. It does not replace it.
ARQ Astra and ARQ Yantra are live and come with a free 14-day trial. ARQ Digital Twin and ARQ Dravya are in development. ARQ DineAstra is planned.
Pricing is on enquiry. Message us and we will quote for your company or plant.

faq.q: Can ARQ build something specific to my factory?
faq.a: Yes. We build small custom apps for one process at a time. See Custom apps.
Manufacturers and MSMEs in India, especially in GIDC and MIDC estates, who keep their books in Tally and their machine records on paper or in Excel.

customApps.intro: Some processes are too specific for a product. We build small, focused apps for one process at a time, and we hand them over in a form your team can run.

patterns.title: Paper to record
patterns.text: Photograph a shop-floor register or sheet, let the software read it, have a person confirm the unsure fields, then run fixed checks on the result. Built as a prototype for a material-tracking workflow.

patterns.title: People and wages
patterns.text: Track contractors or employees, their attendance, advances and payments, in Indian languages. In progress as a parallel project.

patterns.title: A dashboard over what you already keep

about.heading: A small team building practical AI for Indian industry
paragraphs: ARQ ONE AI Labs builds software for Indian manufacturers and MSMEs. We start from the records a business already keeps, like Tally books, machine registers and paper sheets, and turn them into answers an owner can act on.
We started with the Tally data of factories in the GIDC and MIDC belts, because that is where the questions are most practical: who has not paid, what is stuck, what is about to break.
We keep answers short and put the answer before the table. We label what is live, what is in development and what is only planned. And we build for the languages the team actually speaks.
